TestScyllaHelpCommand::test_scylla_help_.description: Runs `scylla --help` (locally from node bin dir, or via docker image entrypoint /bin/scylla), asserts output contains 'Scylla options:', parses option names with a regex (short `-x [ --long ]` and `--long` forms), asserts >100 found and that no option name appears twice. Guards against option registration being duplicated across boost::program_options groups (PR says enterprise --help was 'getting doubled' from time to time); boost only throws ambiguous_option when a duplicated option is actually passed, so startup does not catch it.

origin.summary: Lukasz Sojka: new test for duplicate args in scylla --help (enterprise help was getting doubled); no linked issue.
